title: Studio Access: saving a permission set drops draft values written by another door (`description`, `packageId`) — the save starts from the published body and copies back only editor-managed keys
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

An admin (or agent) sets a description through the API, then touches one checkbox in Studio; the description and packageId are wiped from the draft.

## Reproduction

1. `PUT /api/v1/meta/permission/project_editor_qa?mode=draft&package=com.qa.accesslab` with `description` and `packageId` → 200.
2. Open the set in Studio, click one checkbox → draft now has `description: null`, `packageId: null`.

## Expected

A Studio save preserves every key of the current draft it does not edit.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` ~1288 bases the save on `fresh.effective`; `permission-slice.ts` ~238-243 copies back `EDITOR_AUTHORED_KEYS` only.

## Filing facts

- reach: Studio UI + metadata API, measured by the Access QA card.
- Business reason: Silent data loss between authoring doors.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:access`, p2.
- Dedupe: semantic search `Studio permission set save drops description packageId written by another door` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 10 hits, none about the Studio save base (nearest closed #23259, #23233).
- QA id: A4
